# Testing Conventions

## Rules
- Vitest only; no Jest; tests in `test/` mirroring `src/`; `src/domain/entities/change.ts` → `test/domain/entities/change.spec.ts`
- Unit tests: every use case + every domain entity method that enforces an invariant; mocked ports; no real filesystem or network
- Port mocks: fully implement interface; no `as unknown as Port`; unused methods throw `new Error('not implemented')`
- Integration tests: `FsSpecRepository`, `FsChangeRepository`, other infra adapters against real temp dir (`os.tmpdir()` + unique subfolder per test); cleanup after each test
- POSIX+Windows: every test MUST pass both families; MUST NOT encode host-specific assumptions
- Paths: build/compare with `node:path` (`join`, `resolve`, `sep`); MUST NOT concat with hardcoded `/` or `\`; MUST NOT assert hardcoded POSIX abs paths (`/tmp`, `/var/www`)
- In-memory fixture maps with POSIX keys (e.g. `/project/...`): MUST remap to host abs paths (`path.resolve`) before comparing to host path API values
- Windows drive/backslash rules on non-Windows host: MUST route via Windows path semantics (`path.win32` or equiv mock of `node:path`)
- Spawn/hooks: prefer portable cmds (`node -e`) over POSIX-only builtins (`printf`, `echo`, `sleep`) when asserting product behaviour; Windows `*.cmd` (e.g. `pnpm.cmd`) MUST use shell when required, MAY set `windowsHide`; account for `%PATH%` expansion and cmd vs POSIX quoting
- Logical text identity (content hashes, installed markers): CRLF and lone CR ≡ LF
- Unix-only permission/symlink setups (incl. `chmod 0o000`): MUST NOT be sole unreadability path on Windows — Windows-safe setup or skip where bit has no effect
- Fixtures Windows-valid: temp via `os.tmpdir()`; file URLs from local path (`pathToFileURL`); MUST NOT depend on `/tmp`, `/var/www`, `file:///tmp/...`
- Naming: `.spec.ts` matching source; descriptions `"given <state>, when <action>, then <outcome>"`; helpers `setup<Thing>`/`cleanup<Thing>`
- No snapshot tests; assertions explicit, readable without stored snapshot

## Constraints
- Vitest framework
- Tests in `test/` mirroring `src/`, never co-located
- `.spec.ts` suffix
- Unit tests: no filesystem, network, or spawned processes
- Port mocks fully implement port interface
- Infra integration tests clean temp dirs after each test
- `toMatchSnapshot` / `toMatchInlineSnapshot` forbidden
- Compatible with POSIX and Windows hosts
- Path construction/assertions via `node:path` (or Windows semantics when deliberately testing Windows rules); no hardcoded POSIX abs temp paths
- Process/hook tests: no POSIX-only shell builtins for portable behaviour; handle Windows `*.cmd` spawn and shell expansion/quoting
- Logical text identity for hashes/markers: CRLF/CR ≡ LF
